name: 2C-E-FLY
summary: 2C-E-FLY is a recreational designer drug with psychedelic effects of the phenethylamine, 2C, and FLY families. It is slightly less potent than 2C-E or 2C-B-FLY in animal studies but retains drug-appropriate responding. It is a controlled substance in Canada under phenethylamine blanket-ban language.
